errors.text_span: Стойностите на скалата са равномерно разположени на интервали от 0.25 единици
errors.evidence: The description claims that the y-axis scale has intervals of 0.25 units. The figure does not have a visible y-axis scale, tick marks, or intervals. The numerical values are only shown as data labels on top of each bar.

errors.text_span: най-ниската маркирана стойност е около 3.88, а най-високата е 4.57
errors.evidence: The phrase "маркирана стойност" (marked value) is ambiguous. It refers to the data labels on the bars, not markings on the y-axis scale, which does not exist. A clearer description would state that these are the minimum and maximum data values shown on the bars.
